wiki.title: Henry Dillon (American politician)
wiki.extract: Henry Corby Dillon (born August 8, 1981) is an American politician serving as a member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from the 29th district. Elected on November 8, 2022, he assumed office on December 1, 2022. He previously ran for election in 2016 for the 19th district but did not advance to the general election.
